page.overview:
Who is Cadmus Legion?

The Cadmus Legion was a legion of Darren's minions. They were birthed fully formed from eggs that Darren casted out of the sky. They helped to fight alongside Darren and Maja, but in the end were defeated.

They all have various form with various numbers of eyes. They all appear to be pink, muscular beings.

They have a very brutish personality. They don't seem to think, only do.

After being shot with candy cannon balls, it was shown that these creatures were able to pick up the pieces of their body and assemble them back together. This, of course, can only be done if they aren’t completely blown to ash, like they were with the Ancient Psychic Tandem War Elephant.
